name: github_pr_diff_ts
display_name: GitHub PR Code Review Diff Tool (TypeScript)
description: Fetches pull request metadata, per-file patches, and raw unified diffs from the GitHub REST API to enable automated AI code reviews. Handles pagination, patch truncation, and generated-file filtering so diffs fit inside an LLM context window.

action.description: Action to perform: 'metadata' for PR details, 'files' for per-file patches, 'diff' for the raw unified diff, or 'review_context' for an LLM-ready review payload

pr_url.description: Full pull request URL, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123. Supplying this overrides owner, repo, and pull_number.

owner.description: Repository owner or organization (required unless pr_url is supplied)

repo.description: Repository name (required unless pr_url is supplied)

pull_number.description: Pull request number (required unless pr_url is supplied)

max_files.description: Maximum number of changed files to return (1-300, default 100)

max_patch_chars.description: Maximum characters kept per file patch before truncation (200-100000, default 6000)

max_diff_chars.description: Maximum characters kept for the raw diff when action is 'diff' (500-1000000, default 100000)

include_patch.description: Include the unified patch body for each file. Set false for a lightweight file-name-only summary.

exclude_patterns.description: Glob patterns for files to skip. Defaults to lockfiles and minified assets so generated churn does not consume the model's context.

github_token.description: GitHub personal access token. Falls back to the GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable. Optional for public repositories.
